messages:
mei: FYI a customer asked for an immutable timeline after an autofallback during a rollout. Our Console just shows a one-line banner. Need a convo on playback + retention + evidence access.

harry: Strong +1. We should provide a compact, exportable timeline: event list + minimal context (metric value, policy snapshot, operator). Must be easy to share with customers.

kavi: Telemetry idea: emit `fallback_audit` events keyed by rollout_id and trace_id. Minimal shape below so Console can render a stepper and link evidence blobs.

```json
POST /v1/audit/events
{
  "event":"fallback_audit",
  "rollout_id":"r-223",
  "trace_id":"t-xyz-2026",
  "time":"2026-02-18T15:03:12Z",
  "from_model":"redwood-xl",
  "to_model":"redwood-small",
  "reason":"latency_threshold",
  "trigger_value":"160ms",
  "operator":"auto",
  "policy_snapshot":"s3://policies/r-223/v3.json",
  "evidence_ref":"s3://evidence/r-223/t-xyz-2026/",
  "mixed_attribution":"mixed_kv",
  "attribution_hint":"exact=40,estimated=60"
}
```

cleo: Compliance: retention and redaction must be per-account. Some enterprise customers require 365d unredacted. Others want PII scrubbed immediately. We need: audit_retention_days, redaction_level (none|partial|full), and RBAC gating for unredacted views.

infra-bot: NOTE: default_audit_retention=30d. Temporary creds for evidence blobs issued by infra service.

mei: UX sketch: in Rollouts > History show a small "playback" chevron. Clicking expands an inline timeline with sortable steps (metric, policy-eval, decision, model-switch, operator). Each step has a tiny "evidence" link that opens a time-limited S3 viewer. Show a "redaction state" badge.

harry: Add an export button (JSON/CSV) and a signed-link generator for support teams. Also track "who viewed" when unredacted audit is opened (audit-access-log).

kavi: Backend needs indexes by rollout_id + trace_id and a compact policy diff endpoint: GET /v1/rollouts/{id}/audit?trace=t-xyz-2026 returns the ordered events and a policy_diff object (or link). Console can render changed rules.

cleo: Security: only principals with role.audit.view_unredacted can see raw evidence. When someone opens it emit `audit_view` event with viewer_id + timestamp + redaction_state. Store in immutable append-only log.

mei: Edge case: mixed-attribution when prefix tokens came from primary host and later tokens from fallback. Playback should show spans (trace-span ids) and attribution per-span. Use our tracing IDs so UI can stitch visualization.

harry: Small POI: billing needs model-level token attribution for disputed invoices. We'll include per-event token_counts and attribution_hint. Billing will reconcile.

infra-bot: Deploy: small canary of audit-indexer rolling out now.

mei: Plan/owners: kavi (telemetry + API), harry (console + export), cleo (compliance & RBAC), infra (signed-urls). I'll file the ticket and link the runbook: http://go/runbooks/fallback-audit.
